references_policy: Approved style tests only; no unapproved art or rejects. 27 October priority and five-image cap apply.

attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: L23 assoc_busan/key.png, a full-detail architectural establishing reference, one uninterrupted landscape image at 1536 x 1024 pixels, no borders or inset panels. Modern Korean port city in autumn. Branch Chief Yang's cluttered office inside an old 1990s Hunter Association building at the port. Camera from the entrance corner at 2.2 m high, angled gently down across a 7 m by 6 m room; one coherent two-point perspective, 3 m ceiling, ordinary 2.1 m door visible left. A broad worn wooden desk occupies the middle-left, its working side and high-backed rolling chair behind it, two visitor chairs in front, clear walking space to the right. The desk has blank paper stacks, plain folders, a black corded desk telephone, a tea mug and an unlit desk lamp, all resting solidly on surfaces. Left wall: a large muted blue-and-grey drawn coastal map with coloured pinheads; map contains only coastlines, NO labels or glyphs. Below and beside it plain filing cabinets and shelves with a few old tarnished cup trophies, all trophy plaques BLANK. On the rear wall toward the middle, a large wall-mounted video-call display with its ENTIRE visible screen uniformly flat #00FF00, absolutely no reflection, UI, picture or frame decoration on the green area. Right wall: broad old aluminium-framed windows overlooking working docks, distant tall gantry cranes and grey harbour water. Flat overcast 8:30 AM morning light from the right windows is the key light; visible ceiling fluorescent tubes give weak cool fill, all shadows clean cool-grey cel shapes. Worn pale grey walls, slate-blue linoleum, dark wood accents; green screen is a practical placeholder, not glowing power. Full drawing detail appropriate to a location key, clean black architectural ink, restrained surface wear without gritty noise. One tiny generic adult staff member near the far window for scale, not a named character: 1.75 m, 7.5 heads, long legs half the height, plain grey cardigan and trousers, seen side-back turning to look through the window, hand holding a plain folder, feet planted on the same floor plane, no more than 14 percent of image height. Calm pale upper wall and ceiling. Reference Image 1 is ONLY a house-style rendering anchor: reproduce its clean ink and large opaque cel shadows; do not copy its people, dungeon, props, red light, composition or lettering.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
problems: Scale figure too prominent for a location key.
Overly glossy floor and desk compared with intended graphic cel rendering.

verification.ordinary_files_verified: PowerShell LinkType empty and fsutil hardlink list returned exactly one path for every kept PNG and reject.
verification.visual_checks: Inspected full images, 200-pixel-wide thumbnails, and native-pixel crops enlarged to 200% in memory. No project preview files were saved.
verification.disk_guard: Get-PSDrive C checked before each image-generation call; all seven checks exceeded 3 GiB.
